name: node-render
description: Browse the graph from a pane: a node picker, a meta strip (author · time · trigger), and that node's LIVE preview document loaded in an iframe, plus refresh, open-in-a-tab and 'set as active' buttons. The preview is the same document /preview/node/<id> serves, so the node's panes render and THEIR SCRIPTS RUN — the iframe is sandboxed allow-scripts WITHOUT allow-same-origin (an opaque origin, with no access to this page, the daemon or your cookies) and the document carries a CSP that blocks all network access. Use for peeking at past nodes beside the live surface, or to anchor a reference to a specific node. Params: { node_id: string }.
